name: Concord University
academic_ranking: Public regional university founded 1872 in Athens, WV. Fall 2024 enrollment ~1,956 (~1,389 undergrad). Test-optional admissions with ~89.6% acceptance rate (2025) and ~3.4 avg HS GPA. U.S. News 2026: tied #90 of 135 Regional Universities South, tied #46 Top Public Schools, tied #79 Top Performers on Social Mobility.
financial_aid: Concord University is a public institution; West Virginia residents receive in-state tuition rates while out-of-state students pay a higher rate. Specific published tuition/fee figures could not be verified from a live official source at research time (2026-07); financial aid packages (federal, state, and institutional aid/scholarships) available via the CU Financial Aid office.
facilities_notes: Softball competes as the Concord Mountain Lions on the Athens, WV campus (123-acre knoll overlooking the Appalachian Mountains). Specific softball facility/stadium details not confirmed from a live official source at research time.
program_reputation: NCAA Division II program competing in the Mountain East Conference (MEC) as the Concord Mountain Lions.
notes: Coaching staff and roster captured live from cumountainlions.com on 2026-07. Roster size = 20 players (2026 roster). Tuition and scholarship_count left null; no public figures could be verified from a live authoritative source at research time.
